articles.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
articles.summary: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
articles.paragraph: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app. Commerce Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US Lauren Forristal 7:29 AM PDT · October 15, 2026 Google on Thursday said “Universal Cart,” a tool that lets users collect and monitor products they find across search and in the Gemini app, is now available to U.S. users. The company first previewed the tool at Google I/O in May. The idea is to make online shopping easier to manage. Find something you like, save it to your cart, and move on. When you return later, your items and shopping progress are still there, so you don’t have to hunt down the same products or start over.

articles.title: 007 First Light is finally coming to Nintendo Switch 2 next year — 'The development team will use the coming months to continue refining the game's optimisation'
articles.summary: IO Interactive has finally announced that 007 First Light will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on March 18, 2027.
articles.paragraph: IO Interactive has finally announced that 007 First Light will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on March 18, 2027. The release date is much later than initially promised — IOI originally said the Switch 2 edition would arrive this year after the game's PS5, Xbox, and PC launch in May — however, it's now said that the delay allowed the team extra time to address performance issues and that it will continue to improve optimisation in the following months. "Since announcing additional development time to ensure the quality of experience players expect, IO Interactive has brought hands-on builds of 007 First Light to both Gamescom and Tokyo Game Show, where players and press had their first opportunity to experience Bond's world running on Nintendo's hardware," IOI said in a statement.

articles.title: How To Build Your Team With Autonomous Humans, Not Just Autonomous Systems
articles.summary: As AI enables smaller, faster teams, companies should hire curious, adaptable people who challenge established practices and can be trusted to make independent decisions, according to guest author Eri...
articles.paragraph: As AI enables smaller, faster teams, companies should hire curious, adaptable people who challenge established practices and can be trusted to make independent decisions, according to guest author Eric Francia, who writes that giving employees real responsibility, encouraging questions and investing in continuous learning helps teams innovate, stay engaged and retain talent. How would you handle a junior employee questioning the way you’ve always done something? Might you roll your eyes and dismiss their comments as naivety? Or would you indulge their curiosity? As AI has made knowledge accessible on a scale never seen before, companies are becoming leaner and operating faster. What once took a large team months to do can now be done by a handful of people in a few days.

articles.title: India's cobras share genetic ties across the mainland, while Sri Lankan cobras form a distinct genetic lineage
articles.summary: The spectacled cobra (Naja naja) is one of India's "big four" snakes responsible for most serious snakebite cases.
articles.paragraph: The spectacled cobra (Naja naja) is one of India's "big four" snakes responsible for most serious snakebite cases. It is currently considered one species, which lives across much of South Asia, with regional differences in color, hood markings and venom. However, it's still unclear which regional cobra populations represent separate evolutionary groups. A new study published in Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution has helped parse out which groups have different lineages, and when and where they may have diverged from their ancestors.

articles.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
articles.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic comme...
articles.paragraph: Mastercard and BVNK launched the Global Money Platform, letting businesses embed multi-currency accounts holding fiat and stablecoins. Mastercard is folding stablecoins into its sprawling payments empire, launching a platform that lets businesses hold, move, and spend traditional currencies and digital dollars side by side through a single connection. Unveiled Thursday, the Mastercard Global Money Platform pairs the payments giant’s global network with the stablecoin infrastructure of BVNK, the crypto firm Mastercard acquired in August. Mastercard struck the deal to buy BVNK for roughly $1.8 billion, and the new platform marks the first major integration of the two companies’ capabilities since that acquisition closed.

articles.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
articles.summary: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.
articles.paragraph: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged Bitcoin bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated. Bitcoin fell below $80,000 on Thursday for the first time in over a month, extending Wednesday’s inflation-driven slide and wiping out nearly $1 billion in leveraged crypto bets. It's currently trading just about $82,000 after several hours of increased volatility. Ethereum and XRP dropped close to 5%, Zcash sank almost 10%, and only five coins in the top 100 managed gains above 1%. Pick any coin in the top 100 and it's likely in the red today. Across the market, 177,440 traders were liquidated in 24 hours for a total of $948.22 million, per CoinGlass, with longs accounting for $858.96 million, or 90.6%.
